title: Niagara Falls Night Tour Dinner and Fireworks Boat Cruise
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
REQUIRED: BOOK 5 DAYS IN ADVANCE
Due to high ticket demand, this exclusive tour must be booked at least 5 days prior. Last-minute bookings cannot be guaranteed.

Tour Details:
• Start Time: 6:30 PM
• Meeting Point: Skylon Tower base (5200 Robinson St).
• Scenic Walk: Your guide will share thrilling stories of Niagara daredevils as you walk to Nikola Tesla Plaza.
• Fallsview Dinner: Enjoy a premium 3-course dinner with spectacular views of the illuminated falls.
• Fireworks Cruise: Board the Niagara City Cruises boat. Sail close to the falls under a spectacular fireworks show.

Included:
• Professional local guide
• Premium 3-course dinner
• Fireworks Boat Tour ticket
• 1 souvenir digital photo
